name: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians
definition: A ray-marching algorithm implemented on 3D Gaussians to study the impact of approximations like spatial overlap and sorting in 3DGS.
summary: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians is a volumetric rendering technique that evaluates Gaussian mixtures along camera rays to accurately resolve spatial overlap and self-attenuation, distinguishing itself from standard rasterization-based splatting by using adaptive sampling for precise volumetric integration.
